title: India's tiger count, animated

scenes.label: of the world's wild tigers live in India
scenes.source: Press Information Bureau, Govt of India

scenes.headline: Camera traps plus surveys on foot
scenes.body: The 2022 estimate covered more than 6.41 lakh km walked by field teams.

caption:
From 1,411 to 3,682.

India's tiger estimate is repeated every four years, using camera traps that identify individual tigers by their unique stripe patterns. Tigers are still listed as Endangered globally.

Source: Press Information Bureau (All India Tiger Estimation 2022), IUCN Red List.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Motion-graphics piece built only from card, chart and stat layouts; one real photo as the stat backdrop. Numbers are official mean estimates, labelled as such.
